summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and related changes in the rich repo, without committing or running tests. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished property based on finished_time, _reset clears it, new TimeElapsedColumn, capture in update/advance, clear in reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with local imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns after TimeRemainingColumn with expected output regenerated by clock-read trace); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entries). Verification was by reading and grep only: test_columns was NOT run. Expected output was derived by tracing clock reads (10 reads per unfinished started task per frame, 9 per finished task) and checked against the base trace, which reproduces the base speeds. Bar widths were confirmed with exact-count regexes, and 12 elapsed cells were confirmed. Note the finished-frame bar shrinks by 7 rather than 8 because the speed column also narrows from its changed value.
